description: This Java source file defines the ReadOnlyHelperDAO class, which implements a read-only data access object for entities in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for retrieving entity data without modifying the database, including find by primary key, partial find, count, and relation queries.

classes.name: ReadOnlyHelperDAO
classes.description: A DAO class providing read-only access to entity data, implementing the GenericHelper interface.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Read-only, does not create entities in the database; always returns null.

methods.name: createAll
methods.description: Read-only, does not create entities in the database; always returns null.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Finds an entity by primary key, retrieves data from the database.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Finds an entity by primary key, retrieving only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entities by their primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Read-only, does not remove entities; always returns 0.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching conditions, returns an iterator.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds related entities through multiple relations.

methods.name: removeByCondition
